title: Lior and the Archive
author: Edmund Pemberton
blurb: Wendell Underhill, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
